purpose: Cross-repository reuse-before-invention discovery index for engineering agents. This index identifies likely canonical owners, donor capabilities, compatibility consumers, and evidence surfaces; it does not select CapabilityPlanner routes, workers, models, approval, integration, release, or production authority.

repositories.domain: Governance/collaboration and cross-repository integration host: current CapabilityPlanner authority, execution-lane policy, Task/Issue collaboration contracts, capability discovery, External Intelligence control-plane integration, and retained legacy/compatibility surfaces. New canonical Core/Learning/Open SWE/Repository Intelligence implementation belongs in its owner repository.

Local execution/control transport: allowed roots, isolated workspaces/worktrees, process/session identity, bounded local-agent execution, durable operations, reconciliation, cutover/restart and host-control mechanics. Chat Swarm/provider/carrier strategies remain replaceable consumers of these control primitives and do not own Nexus routing or completion truth.

Evidence Trust Core + Completion Certification truth: evidence ingestion/normalization/integrity, ChangeSet verification reduction, certification policy and receipts. It does not own execution-lane selection, CapabilityPlanner routing, Workforce selection, agent launching, protected merge, release or deployment authority.

Evidence-bounded learning, outcome/effectiveness measurement, projections, recommendations and externally validated adoption/rollback contracts. Recommendation is not route, workforce, approval, merge or production authority.

Replaceable external execution runtime: semantic execution, diagnosis, bounded repair, model transport and authorized tool execution. It does not own Completion truth, Repository Intelligence truth, routing or governance authority.

Deterministic transport-neutral repository/PR/CI advisory intelligence: revision identity, readiness, overlap, CI evidence, change impact, CFI and external-intelligence advisory envelopes. Advisory only; no LLM, worker dispatch, approval, merge or repository-write authority.

Independent planning/admission and execution-coordination package: retry/replan state, writer/event boundaries, durable context/state and explicit composition contracts. Core, Learning, Open SWE and Repository Intelligence remain external owners; provider/service selection is not implicit.

Optional semantic PR-review application and compatibility consumer. It may collect/bind PR evidence, run bounded OpenCLI/ChatGPT semantic review and publish PRE_REVIEW_ONLY advisory output, while canonical deterministic Repository Intelligence remains owned by repository-intelligence-engine.
